name: Security, Privacy & Compliance (SDLC Phase 4)
description: Establishing security and compliance frameworks — aka Trust & Safety, SecOps Hardening, Compliance Sprint, Risk & Assurance.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Security, Privacy & Compliance
capabilities.description: Establishes the security controls, privacy safeguards, and compliance posture required before further platform investment.

checklists.name: Security, Privacy & Compliance (SDLC Phase 4) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for threat modeling, privacy impact assessments, and secure coding practices.

items.statement: Every identified STRIDE threat has a corresponding documented security control or explicit accepted risk.
Data flow diagrams identify all PII ingest, processing, storage, and egress paths with encryption requirements.
Third-party vendor risk assessment is completed for all external APIs and SaaS sub-processors.
Automated secret scanning and SAST vulnerability scanning are enforced in the CI/CD pipeline.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Principle of Least Privilege are explicitly documented.

reviewGates.name: Security Assessment Review
reviewGates.statement: The Security Assessment Report (threat model, security controls, privacy impact assessment) has been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Platform & Developer Experience.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Security Assessment Report show the system's security, privacy, and compliance posture is sufficiently addressed?

obligationDefinitions.title: Security Assessment findings are remediated or formally accepted
obligationDefinitions.description: Every finding raised in the Security Assessment Report (threat model, security controls, privacy impact assessment) must reach a recorded disposition — remediated, or accepted with an approved risk exception — before downstream phases build on this baseline.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: All Security Assessment findings are Remediated or carry an approved risk-acceptance record.

requiredEvidence.title: Security finding closure record
requiredEvidence.description: Evidence that each Security Assessment finding reached a recorded disposition.
requiredEvidence.collectionMethod: Security scan re-run plus sign-off record for accepted risks.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has every Security Assessment finding been remediated or formally risk-accepted?
